arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from test_plan import gen_case
import engine
prof, fab = gen_case(238)
plan = engine.op_plan(prof, fab)
M = engine.get_model(prof, fab); F = M.F; cal = M.cal
N, P, V = F.N, F.P, F.V
g = plan['guard_ns']
bnd, age, pre = plan['bounds_as'], plan['age_rounds'], plan['pred']
Lb=[None]*V; La=[None]*V; Lp=[None]*V
for p in range(P):
    for i in range(N):
        c=p*N+i
        Lb[c]=bnd[p][i]; La[c]=age[p][i]; Lp[c]=None if pre[p][i] is None else (pre[p][i][0],pre[p][i][1])
print('labels:')
for c in range(V):
    print(' ', c, Lb[c], La[c], Lp[c], 'anchor' if F.anchor_mask[c] else '')
# walk check
state=[0]*V
for start in range(V):
    if Lb[start] is None or state[start]: continue
    path=[]; cur=start
    while True:
        if Lb[cur] is None: print('FAIL none labels',cur); break
        if state[cur]==2: break
        if state[cur]==1: print('FAIL cycle',cur); break
        state[cur]=1; path.append(cur)
        pv=Lp[cur]
        if pv is None: break
        v,kind=pv
        pc,ic=divmod(cur,N); ps,isrc=divmod(v,N)
        res=F.step_info(cal,ps,isrc,kind,g)
        if res is None: print('FAIL step not allowed', cur,v,kind); break
        dn,dp,cost,dt=res
        if dn!=ic or dp!=pc: print('FAIL step dst',cur,v,kind,res); break
        if Lb[cur]!=Lb[v]+cost or La[cur]!=La[v]+dt:
            print('FAIL labels',cur,v,kind,Lb[cur],Lb[v]+cost,La[cur],La[v]+dt); break
        cur=v
    for node in path:
        if state[node]!=2:
            if Lp[node] is None and not F.anchor_mask[node]:
                print('FAIL terminal not anchor',node)
            state[node]=2
# closure
def close(u,cost,dt,v):
    if Lb[u] is None: return True
    if Lb[v] is None or La[v] is None: print('FAIL closure finiteness',u,v); return False
    sb=Lb[u]+cost; sa=La[u]+dt; db=Lb[v]; da=La[v]
    if db<sb or (db==sb and da<=sa): return True
    print('FAIL closure inequality',u,v,(db,da),(sb,sa)); return False
ok=True
drift=F.drift_as
for u in range(V):
    if Lb[u] is None: continue
    p,i=divmod(u,N); v=((p+1)%P)*N+i
    ok &= close(u,drift[u],1,v)
for (p,src,dst,dt,cost,code,margin) in F.edges_all:
    if margin<g: continue
    u=p*N+src
    if Lb[u] is None: continue
    v=((p+dt)%P)*N+dst
    ok &= close(u,cost,dt,v)
print('closure ok', ok)
EOF
